notes.title: SOUND AND EVA UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello crew,

In some let's play videos and live - streams, the players dealing with little issues or disturbing events(while running ːsteamhappyː) So we decided to prepare an update to fix them for more comfortable gameplay experience. In short :

+ Running sound effect changed.
+ An indicator adden to EVA mission to guide players.

Enjoy and thank you very much.

notes.title: Reviews and Update #2
notes.content:
Hello crew,

We are really happy about that you guys playing our game, helping each other and solving the problems as much as we do. This is a great thing to see, passionate community! So we looked at every thread every comments and reviews and it all great. We just want to say you guys if you played the game and you have a decision about it, please write a review individually even if it's a single word. Because every single opinion is very important for us to make this game better and possible next games .

Also we just made a patch that makes puzzles more understandable, especially in terminal puzzles in CARGO AREA . We saw there was very confusing points and we tried to redesign the "Help" command for terminals as much as we can.

When we come into the end of the game there was so many good live streams about it and people actually beat the game to the end. But we saw there was a little mistake that we didnt calculate that can cause huge "rage quit" and we fixed that too.

We hope everything goes well(going already) after this patch. Please update your game and lets see what happens.

FARLINK WISHES YOU HAPPY DAY
